title: Procedural worlds and navigation
robloxStudio: 0.746.0.7461269 observed on authoring workstation; recheck on replay
scenario: A bounded seeded depth-first graph generator creates a connected room network with open edges, then the server builds room geometry from the generated graph. A seed reproduces the same route; a new seed produces a different connected map rather than selecting a pre-authored layout.
expectedOutcomes: Same seed produces byte-equivalent logical topology.
Every generated room is reachable and dimensions are bounded.
failureCases: A generated room cannot be reached.
A missing edge produces a sealed route.
